summary.he: פרשת ראה מעמידה לפני האדם ברכה וקללה, ומלמדת שהכלי המקבל את התורה קובע כיצד יתגלה כוחה. שמחה, צדקה, מעשר, אהבת ישראל, זיכרון יציאת מצרים והמועדים בונים חיים שבהם השפע מתקדש ונעשה דרך לעבודת ה׳.
summary.en: Parashas Ri’ay sets blessing and curse before a person and teaches that the vessel receiving Torah determines how its power is revealed. Joy, tzedakah, tithing, love of Israel, remembrance of the Exodus, and the festivals build a life in which abundance is sanctified and becomes a path of avodas Hashem.

map.he: ראייה ובחירה → קבלת התורה בכלי הראוי → צדקה ומעשר → שמחה וזיכרון → קדושת השפע → דבקות וברכה
map.en: Seeing and choosing → receiving Torah in a fitting vessel → tzedakah and tithing → joy and remembrance → sanctified abundance → deveikus and blessing

All this is relevant to the matter, to what extent and how much the power of choice reaches, and is very understandable.

entries.he: ועקר כח הבחירה היא על־ידי שהשם יתברך העלים והסתיר רצונו בהסתרות והעלמות גדולות, ותלה הכל ברצון האדם,בחינת"והארץ נתן לבני אדם",הינו שהשם יתברך מסר הבחירה להאדם, ובדרך שאדם רוצה לילך מוליכין אותו.וכמו שיש כח באדם לשבר תאוותיו ולברח מרע ולעשות טוב, כמו־כן יש לו כח להפך,לילך אחר שרירות לבו ולהתגבר ברצונות רעים כאלו,עד שכביכול יכריח הרע ורצונו תאותו למל
entries.en: And the principle of the power of choice is that the name be blessed by the Most High and hide His will in great mysteries and secrets, and everything depends on the will of man, considering "and the earth was given to the sons of men," that is, that the name be blessed by the gift of choice to man, and in the way that man wants to live, his rulers will rule him. And so on. Just as a person has the power to break his desires and flee from evil and do good, so too does he have the power to turn them around, to let the evil in his heart grow stronger and to grow stronger in such evil desires, until he is completely overcome by evil and his desire is crushed.

entries.he: את יתברך רצונו.כמו לדבר חזק ברצון מאד נכסף שאחד שרואין שבקדשה,לנסע לארץ־ישראל או להצדיק וכיוצא, ויש לו על זה מניעות רבות ועצומות,והוא כמעט מן יוכל אף־על־פי־כן הטבע מדרך ולמעלה הנמנע להתגבר בחשק גדול כזה וברצונות וכסופים חזקים כל־כך, עד שהשם יתברך עושה רצונו ומסבב עמו כדרך שלא נפלאה ובהשגחה נפלאים בדרכים הטבע,עד שזוכה להוציא מחשבתו הטובה מן הכח אל הפעל
entries.en: May his will be blessed. Just as a man with a very strong desire for money, who is seen in the Holy Land, to travel to the Eretz Yisrael or to do good and to go out, faces many obstacles and obstacles, and he is almost overcome, even though nature prevents him from going and ascending with such great strength. And with strong desires and strong winds, all this is done, until the one who does His will is blessed and walks with Him in a way that is not surprising, and with providence, wonders in the paths of nature, until he is worthy to bring forth from his mind the good from the power to the doer.

entries.en: But this is what God has done for this, who not only leads you to speak evil, mercy and peace, but also to go far away to lose souls to know, to learn external wisdom and how to get out, and he also has many obstacles and obstacles, and he is a little bit of a hindrance and not according to the way of nature, he only grows stronger in his wickedness. With such a strong will, until the name is blessed, everything revolves around it until it returns to its place, and all this is due to the great power of choice, for in the way a person wants to go, the ruler of the world will follow.

entries.he: אך החלוק וההפרש יכולין הכל להבין:כי זה האיש הכשר,התכלית בשביל ורצונו כונתו יסוד כל האמתי הנצחי,לפרש מתאוות עולם הזה הכלה והנפסד ולעשות רצונו יתברך,שזה עקר התכלית, והשם יתברך עושה עמו נפלאות למלאת רצונו,ואז בודאי אשרי לו בעולם הזה ובעולם הבא; וזה ההפך כל כונתו ורצונו לתאוות עולם הזה ושרירות לבו הרע,ועל ידי זה יורד לבאר שחת ואחריתו עדי אבד.
entries.en: The division and the interpretation of the whole ability to understand: For this is the man of ability, the path of learning and his will is the foundation of all the victorious truth, to separate from the desires of this world, which is all corrupt and perishable, and to do his will, he will be blessed, for this is the essence of learning, and the place where he will be blessed will do wonders with him. To the fullness of his will, and then I will surely bless him in this world and the Olam HaBa; and this is the reverse of all his intention and his will to the lust of this world and the evil in his heart, and at the hands of this he will descend into the pit of corruption and his end will be even to his loss.

entries.en: When the prophet was moved, so that the will of the prophet might be revealed, so that he might be justified by this to hear the voice of the call of a good day that calls and reveals the will in the form of a holy call (which reveals and proclaims that all who act in accordance with His will will be blessed, as stated in the collections of Tinina - Simand, Aiyen Sham), and then he vomited. One is entitled to rejoice on a good day, because the essence of the joy of a good day is as much as one is entitled to hear the voice of the proclamation of a good day, as in (Psalms Noach): The tzaddik will rejoice because he sees the vengeance of his enemies; he will be washed in the blood of the wicked, etc. (as in the above statement).

entries.en: This is what Rashmi interpreted on the verse 'And you rejoice' above: If you make mine happy, I will make yours happy. That is, if you give charity and make the poor happy, yours will make me happy immediately, and you will be justified immediately, for the joy of a good day, for the joy of a good day is based on tzaddikness. Precisely, it is because of this that one is entitled to hear the voice of the call of a good day that reveals the desire, which is the essence of the joy of a good day, as stated above: And this is what our rabbis, z"l, said regarding the joy of a good day (Pesach 5:). entries.en: The joy of a good day is due to the manifestation of the will, to the wisdom of nature, which is revealed through sacrifices, which are made by this mechanism of the spirit of incapacity that is the bestiality, the wisdom of nature, the wisdom of discernment, for man above the beast and above the beast—and the care for the will of nature, so that it may be blessed. In His providence that all things are known, it was found that, since nature has revealed the wisdom of the sacrifices, the hands of the will, this is the principle of the joy of a good day as above. Therefore, the principle of the joy of a good day in the flesh of the sacrifices is exactly as above.

entries.en: And therefore the above verse: "And you shall rejoice before Hashem, you and your children, etc., and the stranger and the orphan, etc." is said concerning the subject of the sacrifices, because later the sacrifices, in the particulars of the sacrifices of the good day of the holy day, reveal the will, therefore they cry out to give alms from them, to invite upon them the poor and the stranger and the orphan. And so, 'So that by the hand of the one who is convinced of the will, tzaddikness will be revealed by the will, so that by this hand the voice of the call of the good day will be heard, a holy call that reveals the will, which is the essence of the joy of the good day in the garden:'

entries.en: Three times a year all your males shall appear before Hashem your God. The essence of holiness is to believe that everything is by His will and to yearn and long for Him constantly with a strong will. The holiness of the Beis HaMikdash is rooted in the Holy of Holies, the will of wills. Therefore on the three festivals, which reveal holy calling and holy will, one ascends to appear before Hashem. “The face of Hashem” is the light of will, called face. This light is received through tzedakah and willing offerings, and through them the joy and holiness of the festivals are drawn down.
